items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And I had the audacity to approach Mildred Bailey

ctx.x: Okay, so that's been a little digression I guess, by talking about style and singing.

You know, I remember very vividly when I first came to New York, Mildred Bailey was popular. And she was among the musicians, you know, that used to come in because she was probably with Kurby and Buster and Red, you know, they were all together. And I had the audacity to approach Mildred Bailey and here I am, you know, just coming out of left field, but I said to Mildred Bailey I told her, I said, 'I think you're being too much influenced by Billie Holiday.' I don't think it made her very happy and I shouldn't…
